sentences.text: The learned A.P.P. seeks time to call upon the investigating officer to find out present status of the investigation, whether the investigating officer has carried out any further investigation of crime so as to connect the present applicants with the alleged crime.

2. In view of the above, except the confession statement of the co-accused persons,
there is no other evidence to connect the applicants with the alleged crime.
The investigating officer also needs some time to find out the truth.
However, the applicants need to be protected.

sentences.text: In view of the above, until further orders, in the event of arrest of the applicant in anticipatory bail application no. 1450 of 2018, namely, Laxmikant s/o Pandurang Baheti and the applicant in anticipatory bail application no. 1452 of 2018, namely, Govind s/o Ramdas Madrewar in connection with crime no. 315 of 2018 registered with Nilanga Police Station, District Latur, for the offences punishable under sections 188, 272, 273, 328, 34 of I.P.C. and under section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, they be released on furnishing personal bond of Rs.15,000/- each with one surety each of the like amount on the conditions that they shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner and they shall attend the concerned police station once in a week i.e on every Monday between 8.00 a.m. to 11.00 a.m. and shall co-operate the investigating officer as and when required.

( V. K. JADHAV, J.) rlj/
